title: Explain Actions secret naming rules
steps: Inspect the open Add secret dialog and the empty Name field's naming hint.
Enter 1DEPLOY_KEY as the Name and staging-access as the Value.
Click Confirm and inspect the validation popup at the Name field.

video_guide.summary: Enter a secret name beginning with a digit and inspect the generic validation feedback after Confirm.

chapters.label: Inspect the open Add secret dialog.
Enter 1DEPLOY_KEY as Name and staging-access as Value.

chapters.note: Name contains 1DEPLOY_KEY and Value contains staging-access.
Name is focused and a validation popup says Please match the requested format.
The dialog retains both entered values; the visible popup gives the generic format message without the first-character rule.
